title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join our Web Apps team, in our Zürich office. In this role, you will own our cloud infrastructure, automate our pipelines, be proactive and monitor our services, and ensure our systems are secure and cost-efficient.

The web apps team plays a central role at Auterion and owns the systems that add connectivity and remote interfaces for fleet management and operations. Our services are responsible for ingesting and analyzing flight telemetry data, managing and updating the fleet as well as integrating with other systems across the stack.

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Maintain, migrate, and scale our AWS infrastructure using Terraform and best practices for EC2, ECS, and data storage.

- Maintain and optimize our build/deploy pipelines using GoCD and GitHub Actions to ensure seamless delivery of our polyglot services (Node, Python, Rust, C++).

- Manage Docker images and orchestration on ECS to ensure consistent environments from dev to production.

- Implement and monitor metrics, logs, and alerts using Datadog. Proactively analyze traffic patterns to prevent issues before they impact users.

- Take ownership of infrastructure compliance standards, specifically maintaining requirements for SOC2.

- Analyze usage patterns and implement strategies to reduce AWS infrastructure costs without sacrificing performance

- Maintain and improve integrations with 3rd party services

- Audit, maintain and improve security best practices across our public and private access endpoints

Qualifications and Skills

- 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or SRE role.

- Strong proficiency with AWS core services (EC2, ECS, ECR, RDS, IAM).

- Production experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

- Solid experience with Docker and container orchestration.

- Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines is a must (GoCD and GitHub Actions preferred).

- Experience with monitoring tools (Datadog, New Relic, or Prometheus).

- Experience navigating a polyglot environment (Node.js, Python, C++ or Rust) is a plus

- Knowledge of Database administration (Postgres) using ORMs (Prisma) is a plus.

- Experience handling infrastructure SOC2 compliance requirements is a plus.

You will bring real, practical experience of building and flying unmanned aircraft, ideally on PX4 or ArduPilot, combined with a strong grounding in avionics or aeronautical engineering. - Produce clear technical documentation, solution architectures and integration guidance to support bids and deployments.

Qualifications and Skills

- Demonstrable hands-on experience building and flying drones, ideally using PX4 or ArduPilot.

- Proven hands on experience with C++, Docker & Linux.

- Strong background in avionics, aeronautical engineering or a related discipline, with practical understanding of airframes, autopilots, sensors and payload integration.

- Experience working with MAVLink, ground control stations and flight test procedures.

- Proven ability to operate as a technical lead in front of customers, including live demonstrations and field troubleshooting.

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical detail into clear, compelling customer-facing narratives.

title: IT Manager
description:
Overview
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on IT Manager to lead IT systems and infrastructure across our German operations, which now span multiple offices. You will own the security, reliability and compliance of our environment as the company scales quickly in Germany, and you will lead the local IT team, starting with one IT Support Engineer and growing as we expand.

This is a technical leadership role, not a hands-off management role. You will make infrastructure decisions, not just execute them: choosing tooling, designing the network and identity setup across sites, and setting the standards the local team works to. At the same time you stay close to the systems and remain the senior technical escalation point. You will own network and systems administration, identity and access management, and cybersecurity operations, and you will drive the certifications and compliance work required to support our defense customers and joint venture.

This is a fast-moving environment where priorities shift quickly, so the ability to adapt fast, learn new domains quickly, juggle several offices and stay effective under changing demands is essential. Because the role handles export-controlled systems and information, it carries specific compliance and eligibility requirements (see Qualifications). You will work with the support and direction of the global IT function.

Responsibilities and Duties

Team leadership

- Lead the local IT team in Germany (initially one IT Support Engineer, growing with the company): set priorities, coach, review work and ensure the team delivers reliable support across all German offices.

- Act as the senior escalation point for infrastructure, security and access related issues, in coordination with the global IT function.

- Take part in hiring and onboarding of additional IT staff as the German footprint grows.

Infrastructure ownership and decisions

- Own infrastructure decisions for the German offices: evaluate options, propose and select tooling, network and cloud designs, and drive them through to implementation.

- Own the administration and maintenance of network infrastructure across all German offices, including firewalls, switches and wireless networks.

- Manage cloud platforms and licenses, ensuring availability, performance and cost control.

- Administer and maintain the VS-NfD network, ensuring it is configured, operated and documented in line with the applicable classified handling requirements.

- Lead ad-hoc infrastructure projects, including office build-outs and onboarding of new tools as the company expands across sites.

Security, identity and compliance

- Drive and maintain the IT certifications and compliance controls required for defense work and the joint venture, working within applicable export control obligations.

- Administer Identity and Access Management (IAM), including user provisioning, de-provisioning and periodic access reviews.

- Manage cybersecurity tooling, including endpoint protection, vulnerability management, SIEM and phishing simulation platforms.

- Maintain clear documentation for network configurations, IAM processes, security policies and compliance workflows, and ensure the team follows them.

Qualifications and Skills

- EU citizenship is required. This role involves access to export controlled systems and information, which carries legal eligibility requirements.

- Professional working proficiency in German and English.

- Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- At least 3 to 5 years of experience in system administration or IT infrastructure, ideally in a regulated or security conscious environment.

- Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, SSO management and IAM systems.

- Solid understanding of cybersecurity practices, including endpoint security, threat detection and security auditing.

- A hands-on profile: you still configure, troubleshoot and fix systems yourself and expect to keep doing so, alongside guiding the team.

title: Manufacturing Finance Manager
description:
We're looking for a Manufacturing Finance Manager to own the operational accounting and financial management across our supply chain and procurement process - from purchase order through delivery, receipt and invoicing. The role sits within our joint venture manufacturing entity and works closely with both the JV's operations team and Auterion's central finance function. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who understands how physical goods move through a production environment and can translate that into accurate, timely financial reporting and management-ready cost visibility.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Own the procurement-to-invoice process end to end - purchase orders, delivery receipts, goods receipt checks and stock movement - ensuring proper matching and controls at each step and maintaining the document-level audit trail required under applicable accounting standards

- Reconcile deliveries against bills of materials and purchase records, working closely with supply chain and systems teams to keep records accurate and up to date

- Turn delivery and receipt data into accurate, on-time invoicing and build repeatable monthly reconciliation processes

- Identify and correctly account for items delivered outside standard/contracted pricing agreements

- Track actual production costs (direct materials, labor, and overhead) against contract value and budget. Surfacing variances early so operations and management can act swiftly

- Maintain and reconcile WIP balances by production order; tracking physical production progress against system records, supporting accurate period-end inventory valuation and COGS recognition

- Support the build-out of financial controls across procurement and spend, including approval workflows and spend visibility

- Act as the finance counterpart to supply chain and operations teams, providing cost visibility, variance analysis, and the financial and cash-flow impact of production activity

- Maintain a regular on-site presence to verify physical inventory and operations against system records

- Track and control operational spend against budget, including cost category visibility, variance reporting, and enforcement of non-production spend approvals.

Qualifications and Skills

- Experience in supply chain, procurement, or operations finance - manufacturing or hardware environments strongly preferred

- Comfortable working directly with bills of materials, purchase orders and delivery documentation

- Hands-on cost accounting experience in a manufacturing environment: WIP tracking, standard vs. actual cost variance, inventory valuation

- Strong reconciliation and process-control mindset; comfortable building structure where processes are still maturing

- Proven ERP ownership in a manufacturing or supply chain environment required. You build and own processes, not just use them. NetSuite experience is a plus.

- Clear communicator, comfortable working cross-functionally with supply chain, operations and finance stakeholders

Auterion is seeking a Product Marketing Specialist to translate complex autonomy, robotics, and defense technology into clear, market-facing messaging, sales enablement, web content, and campaign materials.

This role partners closely with product, engineering, business development, and marketing to develop technically accurate, customer-focused content for defense and global markets. The ideal candidate has experience marketing defense, aerospace, or other highly technical products and can simplify complex technologies into compelling narratives that resonate with military, government, and commercial audiences. You will play a key role in communicating what Auterion builds, why it matters, and how it delivers mission-critical capabilities in real-world environments.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Develop consistent product positioning, messaging, and use-case narratives for Auterion's autonomy and robotics solutions.

- Partner with product, engineering, and business development teams to translate technical capabilities into compelling customer-facing marketing materials.

- Create content for websites, landing pages, sales enablement, campaigns, presentations, one-pagers, events, and product launches.

- Build use-case narratives that connect product capabilities to customer needs, operational environments, and mission outcomes.

- Support customer-facing teams with clear sales materials, competitive positioning, and value messaging.

- Adapt messaging for different defense audiences, geographic markets, and stages of the customer journey.

- Support product launches, announcements, demonstrations, campaigns, and field events with messaging, collateral, and web updates.

Qualifications and Skills

- 2-5 years of experience in product marketing, digital marketing, technical marketing, solutions marketing, sales enablement, or a related role.

- Experience marketing products or technologies within the defense, aerospace, national security, or government sectors is highly preferred.

- Experience marketing complex technical products in B2B and/or B2G environments.

- Strong writing, editing, and communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for a range of audiences.

- Experience partnering with product, engineering, sales, and business development teams to create accurate and effective marketing content.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Production Engineer
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.

- Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.

- Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.

- Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.

- Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.

- Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.

- Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.

- Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

- Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.

- 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.

- CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.

- Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.

- Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

- Good verbal and written English communication skills.

title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to build and deploy perception systems that run onboard autonomous aerial platforms. This is not offline research. Our algorithms run in real time on embedded computers, in the air, in conditions we do not control.

You will work across the full stack of the problem: classical computer vision and deep learning, camera and sensor selection, calibration, model training and evaluation, and optimization for constrained hardware. You will take your work to the field, fly it, look at the logs, and improve it. Our platforms serve both commercial and government customers across applications including inspection, mapping, search and rescue and security.

If you like hard real world problems and short feedback loops between an idea and a flight test, we want to talk with you.

Responsibilities and Duties

- Design, implement and optimize onboard perception algorithms for real time detection, temporal association and state estimation of dynamic objects from a moving platform.

- Train, retrain and evaluate neural networks for detection and classification, including dataset curation, labelling strategy and evaluation methodology.

- Optimize models and pipelines for embedded inference, working to explicit latency, throughput and compute budgets.

- Develop and maintain camera calibration and sensor synchronization procedures, including multi camera and multi sensor setups.

- Combine visual measurements with inertial and platform state data using filtering and estimation techniques for robust performance under egomotion.

- Plan and run field test campaigns. Take algorithms from bench to flight, work with pilots and integrators on site, and close the loop on real captured data.

- Build repeatable evaluation methods so that performance and accuracy are measurable across every iteration rather than judged by eye.

- Provide input into camera, lens, sensor and compute selection, and evaluate hardware options against real performance data.

- Take full ownership of computer vision deliverables. Disambiguate requirements, drive alignment across teams, keep stakeholders informed and see work through to the customer.

- Mentor and coach other engineers, and raise the bar on product quality.

Qualifications and Skills

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong hands on experience deploying computer vision systems on resource constrained platforms, ideally robotic or aerial.

- Solid grounding in classical computer vision: feature detection and matching, optical flow, camera models and calibration, multiple view geometry.

- Practical experience training and deploying convolutional neural networks for detection or classification, including the unglamorous parts: data collection, labelling quality, retraining loops and honest evaluation.

- Rigor about timing and synchronization across sensors. Understanding of why timestamps, exposure timing and latency matter, and experience debugging problems that turned out to be timing problems.

- Proficiency in C++ and Python, with real experience in OpenCV.

- Track record of taking computer vision work end to end, from problem definition to something running in a real deployment.

- Comfort with field work, including travel to test sites and debugging from real world logs and video.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead across teams in a fast moving environment.

- Effective communication and collaboration across engineering, product and external stakeholders.

- EU citizenship required.

Nice to have

- State estimation and sensor fusion. Kalman and extended Kalman filters, IMU integration, estimation under egomotion.

- Experience with visual inertial odometry or visual SLAM, or other hard estimation work on a moving platform.

- Experience with ROS2 or similar middleware.

- Experience with embedded inference runtimes and model optimization such as quantization or pruning.

- Familiarity with GPU or NPU accelerated pipelines on embedded SoCs.

- Experience building CI or hardware in the loop infrastructure for perception regression testing.

- Background in aerial platforms, PX4 or MAVLink based systems.

Benefits

- Company pension plan

- Car parking
